estimand.definition: mean measured ultimate shear resistance per headed stud
evidence: https://wrap.warwick.ac.uk/id/eprint/162336/1/WRAP-Machine-learning-models-predicting-resistance-headed-studs-embedded-concrete-2022.pdf: mean measured resistance per stud (Pem), kN
https://wrap.warwick.ac.uk/id/eprint/179609/1/WRAP-experimental-data-shear-resistance-studs-welded-ribs-steel-transverse-beams-23.pdf: mean measured shear resistance per stud, Pem
https://www.mdpi.com/2075-5309/12/5/505: stud ultimate shear load; the RAC archive labels the field P_em
estimand.name: P_em
estimand.rejection_rule: reject a parent if its target is total specimen load, design resistance, prediction, or another quantity that cannot be shown to equal measured per-stud resistance in kN

pretarget_feature_audit.missing_rule: complete-case on target plus all seven frozen common features; no imputation
pretarget_feature_audit.range_rule: retain out-of-development feature support and report it; do not clip or extrapolation-filter after target access

row_exclusions_in_order: remove rows missing the target or any frozen common feature
remove nonfinite or nonpositive target values as data-invalid, reporting every removal
do not remove statistical outliers or high-error rows
unresolved_source_rule: retain rows in point estimates; assign all unresolved citations to one shared __UNRESOLVED_SOURCE__ cluster for conservative source-bootstrap dependence; do not count that cluster toward the ten-source admission gate
